description: Nationalities whose holders may work in the Netherlands without a residence document or work permit: the 27 EU member states, the three other EEA states and Switzerland. Codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, the form the machine-readable zone of a passport or ID card uses. Germany writes D in the zone instead of DEU, so D is listed as an alias.
source: Wet arbeid vreemdelingen art. 1 (EU/EER-onderdanen en Zwitsers zijn vrijgesteld van de TWV-plicht); EU member states per https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries_en; EEA per the EEA Agreement (IS, LI, NO); Switzerland per the EU-Switzerland agreement on the free movement of persons. Checked 2026-09-29.
